name: Archangel of Tithes
oracle_text:
Flying
As long as this creature is untapped, creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.
As long as this creature is attacking, creatures can't block unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.
blocked_sentences: As long as this creature is attacking, creatures can't block unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.

needs.what: A static effect, the blocking twin of attack_tax: at declare-blockers each creature its `affects` filter matches can be declared as a blocker only if its controller pays a mana `cost` per blocking creature (here {1}, affects: all creatures, controller any). Must be gateable by a static condition reading the source's own combat status ('as long as this creature is attacking'), so the static condition language also needs a self-is-attacking test (an `exists` over {self_only, attacking} would do if `exists` honours `attacking`).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: attack_tax prices only declaring attackers (read in legality/game._pay_attack_tax at declare-attackers). block_restriction refuses blockers by a printed-characteristic filter or require_all, with no cost/payment path. The cant_block static and op are absolute prohibitions, not payable ones. Nothing in static_effects charges mana at declare-blockers.
